sentence: This is a 54-year-old female patient, diagnosed with partial edentulism of both arches and severe Seibert class III alveolar atrophy1 in the edentulous premaxilla region.
The treatment plan consists of the placement of 2 autoclaved hydrogel beads for tissue expansion of the premaxilla, and a subsequent block bone allograft in the same place.

Two weeks after the placement of the hydrogel beads, they were exposed and removed, with the placement of Biograft® brand allograft blocks, transsurgically preformed by means of stereolithography, wound closure could be performed without tension and without the need to discharge the flap, or incisions to release tension in the periosteum.

Once the osseointegration period of the block is completed (approximately 6 months), the placement of the dental implants is carried out, initially planned in a suitable position, with very good bone and soft tissue for their rehabilitation.
